description: Single long event-loop stall on one process, from nodejs.eventloop.delay.max over moltnet-metrics. Percentile delay hides a few multi-second stalls among many short ticks; the maximum does not. A stall delays every request on that instance, including heartbeats and commits. Group shows service.name and service.instance.id: find traces on that instance around the alert time with the longest synchronous span. Values are seconds.
mplQuery:
`moltnet-metrics`:`nodejs.eventloop.delay.max`
| align to 5m using max
| group by `service.name`, `service.instance.id` using max
name: MoltNet event loop stall by instance
